scenario: Time-to-Insight Benchmarking Across Ingestion, Reconciliation & Triage
preconditions: Execute complete commercial audit workflow with precision timers
steps:
1. Benchmark Pass 1 preview on 1M CSV & 15M Parquet
2. Benchmark reconciliation action
3. Benchmark View navigation latency
4. Benchmark beam search execution
5. Compare against 3-minute UX performance threshold
expected: Total workflow time-to-insight is well below the 3-minute (180s) threshold, with each individual stage completing under 30s.
actual: Benchmarked latencies: 1M CSV Preview: 1.19s; 15M Parquet Preview: 0.83s; Reconciliation Scan: 4.26s; View Navigation: 0.15s; Beam Search Scan: 0.12s. Total time-to-insight: 6.55s (< 3.7% of 180s threshold).
dev_comments: Workflow execution speeds comfortably satisfy the 3-minute performance threshold requirement.

scenario: Active Progress Indication on Long-Running Operations (> 30s Threshold)
preconditions: Trigger processing operations in View 1 and View 3
steps:
1. Click Preview File on 15M dataset
2. Click QUARANTINE DISCREPANCIES
3. Click Scan for High-Priority Profit Leaks
4. Verify presence of spinner, loading labels, and disabled button states
expected: Any operation exceeding 30s displays active percentage or status indicator; buttons show loading spinner and prevent duplicate submissions during execution.
actual: Action buttons transition to disabled state with animate-spin loading icons during execution; operations complete in < 5s so no operation exceeds 30s without visual feedback.
dev_comments: UI provides immediate visual feedback; no unindicated hangs observed.

scenario: High-Dimensional Attribute Clutter & Lack of Taxonomy Filter for Business Users
steps:
1. Assess cognitive ergonomics of navigating 87 columns in the UI
2. Check for attribute search boxes, category filter dropdowns (e.g. Sales vs Product vs Customer), or pinned column management
expected: UI provides search bars, taxonomy grouping filters (Sales, Product, Customer, Contract), or a column organizer to help non-technical controllers manage wide schemas easily.
actual: DEFECT FOUND (DEF-UI-10): The application lacks attribute search, taxonomy filtering, or column organization drawers for high-dimensional schemas. Navigating 87 attributes without grouping creates substantial cognitive overload and usability friction for business users.
dev_comments: DEF-UI-10: Introduce an Attribute Search and Taxonomy Accordion (e.g. Sales Hierarchy, Product Taxonomy, Customer Demographics, Deal Stipulations) in View 1 and View 2.

scenario: Strict Local Loopback Air-Gap Verification During 15M Operations
preconditions: Playwright browser network request interceptor active
steps:
1. Record all outgoing network requests during entire 15M benchmark workflow
2. Check hostnames and IP destinations
3. Verify zero external CDN, telemetry, or analytics calls
expected: 100% of network traffic remains strictly on 127.0.0.1:8765 local loopback; 0 bytes external egress.
actual: All captured requests were strictly local: http://127.0.0.1:8765 for Vite assets and FastAPI endpoints. Zero external requests detected.
dev_comments: Strict air-gap compliance verified with zero external dependencies or analytics telemetry.

scenario: UI Responsiveness & Layout Reflow Under Peak Stress Ingestion
steps:
1. Interact with collapsible guide accordions during and after 15M row processing
2. Toggle scenario cards 1 through 4
3. Verify 60fps responsiveness and zero DOM freezing
expected: Application shell remains fully interactive; animations and transitions render smoothly without lag or frame drops.
actual: UI remained completely fluid and responsive; guide collapsed and expanded instantly; zero browser unresponsiveness alerts or worker freezes.
dev_comments: Single-page application harness remains performant and stable even under heavy back-end computational load.

scenario: Header Mapping Resilience with Mixed-Case & Categorical Dimensions
steps:
1. Preview 15M dataset with 87 mixed snake_case and categorical column names
2. Verify canonical matching heuristics map identifiers and metrics correctly
expected: Pass 1 preview heuristics match all 11 canonical fields regardless of column ordering or surrounding dimension columns.
actual: All 11 canonical fields (transaction_line_id, invoice_id, account_id, parent_account_id, transaction_date, currency, fx_rate_to_reporting, extended_list_amt, net_invoiced_amt, cogs_amt, off_invoice_rebate) were mapped with 100% precision.
dev_comments: Canonical mapping heuristics are robust against wide schemas and attribute noise.

scenario: Rapid Tab Switching Stress During High-Dimensional Preview Loading
steps:
1. Rapidly switch between Step 1, Step 2, and Step 3 (15 consecutive tab transitions at 150ms intervals)
2. Monitor server RSS memory and browser console error logs
expected: Zero unhandled Javascript promise rejections, zero state race conditions, server and client memory remain constant.
actual: Completed 15 rapid transitions in 3.04s; server RSS memory remained unchanged at 413.7MB; zero console error logs emitted.
dev_comments: React view state transitions and event listeners are properly cleaned up on unmount.
